items.name: wa-li-webhook
items.title: WhatsApp webhook
items.description: Next.js route for the WhatsApp Cloud API webhook plus the wa-li client config (Supabase adapter, Meta direct transport).
items.docs: wa-li webhook installed. In Meta App Dashboard > WhatsApp > Configuration set the Callback URL to https://<your-domain>/api/whatsapp and the Verify token to WA_VERIFY_TOKEN, then subscribe to the "messages" field. Each wa_accounts.token_ref names the env var holding that number's access token (e.g. WA_TOKEN_MAIN). Install @quami/wa-li-schema for the database, then run `npx @quami/wa-li doctor`.

items.name: wa-li-schema
items.title: WhatsApp schema (Supabase)
items.description: Supabase migration with the wa_* tables, RLS, locks and pruning functions used by wa-li.
items.docs: Migration added to supabase/migrations/. Apply it with `supabase db push` (or `supabase db reset` locally) and create a private Storage bucket named WA_STORAGE_BUCKET (default whatsapp-media).
